examples.chinese: 這件衣服的顏色很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de yánsè hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: The color of this clothing is very pretty.

examples.chinese: 這件衣服的顏色很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de yánsè hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: The color of this clothing is very pretty.

examples.chinese: 這件衣服的顏色很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de yánsè hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: The color of this clothing is very pretty.

examples.chinese: 我想友美喜歡白色，她常常穿白色的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng Yǒuměi xǐhuān báisè, tā chángcháng chuān báisè de yīfu.
examples.english: I think Youmei likes white, she often wears white (clothes).

examples.chinese: 你的錢包在那件衣服下面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de qiánbāo zài nà jiàn yīfu xiàmiàn.
examples.english: Your wallet is under that piece of clothing.

examples.chinese: 去年她送我一本書，今年我要送她一件衣服。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián tā sòng wǒ yī běn shū, jīnnián wǒ yào sòng tā yī jiàn yīfu.
examples.english: Last year she gave me a book; this year I want to give her a piece of clothing.

examples.chinese: 這個牌子的衣服又便宜又好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhège páizi de yīfu yòu piányi yòu hǎokàn.
examples.english: Clothes of this brand are both cheap and good-looking.

examples.chinese: 今天大家都穿很多衣服，因為天氣太冷了。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān dàjiā dōu chuān hěn duō yīfu, yīnwèi tiānqì tài lěng le.
examples.english: Today everyone is wearing a lot of clothes because the weather is too cold.

examples.chinese: A:我妹妹說這件衣服很好看，你覺得呢？ B:這件衣服真的很好看！
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ mèimei shuō zhè jiàn yīfu hěn hǎokàn, nǐ juéde ne? B: Zhè jiàn yīfu zhēn de hěn hǎokàn!
examples.english: A: My younger sister says this piece of clothing looks very nice; what do you think? B: This piece of clothing really looks very nice!

examples.chinese: 那件衣服有一點兒舊，可是還可以穿很久。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn yīfu yǒu yīdiǎnr jiù, kěshì hái kěyǐ chuān hěn jiǔ.
examples.english: That piece of clothing is a little old, but can still be worn for a long time.

examples.chinese: 我想先換衣服再去運動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiān huàn yīfu zài qù yùndòng.
examples.english: I want to change clothes first and then go exercise.

examples.chinese: 沒想到我奶奶那個年代流行的衣服，現在又流行起來了。李小龍（Bruce Lee）是七○年 （qīlíng niándài，1970∼1979） 非常有名的功夫明星。
examples.pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào wǒ nǎinai nàge niándài liúxíng de yīfu, xiànzài yòu liúxíng qǐlái le. Lǐ Xiǎolóng (Bruce Lee) shì qīlíng niándài fēicháng yǒumíng de gōngfu míngxīng.
examples.english: I never thought that the clothes that were popular in my grandmother's era would become popular again now. Bruce Lee was a very famous martial arts star in the 1970s.

examples.chinese: 小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi. Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english: Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes. My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 在我爺爺奶奶的年代，生活比較辛苦，不少窮人為了省錢，衣服破了還是繼續穿。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ yéye nǎinai de niándài, shēnghuó bǐjiào xīnkǔ, bùshǎo qióngrén wèile shěng qián, yīfu pò le háishì jìxù chuān.
examples.english: In my grandparents' era, life was relatively hard; many poor people, in order to save money, continued to wear clothes even after they were torn.

examples.chinese: 張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē. Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate. My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le. Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.
examples.english: Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's. Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size.

examples.chinese: 糟了！衣服被咖啡弄髒了，我得換一件才能出門。
examples.pinyin: Zāo le! Yīfu bèi kāfēi nòng zāng le, wǒ děi huàn yī jiàn cái néng chūmén.
examples.english: Uh-oh! My clothes got dirty from coffee; I have to change into another piece before I can go out.

examples.chinese: 大地震過後才幾天，這個災區的民眾除了收到許多衣服和食物，還收到五千萬元，讓大家又驚訝又感動。
examples.pinyin: Dà dìzhèn guòhòu cái jǐ tiān, zhège zāiqū de mínzhòng chúle shōudào xǔduō yīfu hé shíwù, hái shōudào wǔqiān wàn yuán, ràng dàjiā yòu jīngyà yòu gǎndòng.
examples.english: Only a few days after the major earthquake, the people in this disaster area not only received many clothes and food, but also received fifty million dollars, which made everyone both surprised and moved.

examples.chinese: 天空突然下起了大雨，我的衣服和頭髮都濕了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānkōng tūrán xià qǐ le dà yǔ, wǒ de yīfu hé tóufa dōu shī le.
examples.english: Suddenly it started raining heavily, and my clothes and hair all got wet.

examples.chinese: 白小姐平時對穿著不怎麼講究，衣服穿來穿去總是那幾件。
examples.pinyin: Bái xiǎojiě píngshí duì chuānzhuó bù zěnme jiǎngjiu, yīfu chuān lái chuān qù zǒngshì nà jǐ jiàn.
examples.english: Miss Bai doesn't pay much attention to clothing in normal times; the clothes she wears are always just those few pieces.

examples.chinese: 我認為多看時尚雜誌、多看模特兒怎麼穿衣服，應該就能使自己的穿著更有品味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi duō kàn shíshàng zázhì, duō kàn mótè'er zěnme chuān yīfu, yīnggāi jiù néng shǐ zìjǐ de chuānzhuó gèng yǒu pǐnwèi.
examples.english: I think that by reading more fashion magazines and looking more at how models wear clothes, you should be able to make your own clothing more tasteful.

examples.chinese: A:「快時尚」的服裝只有剛出來的頭幾個月受歡迎。 B:哦？你的意思是「快時尚」的衣服很快就失去魅力了嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: “Kuàishíshàng” de fúzhuāng zhǐyǒu gāng chūlái de tóu jǐ ge yuè shòu huānyíng. B: Ó? Nǐ de yìsi shì “kuàishíshàng” de yīfu hěn kuài jiù shīqù mèilì le ma?
examples.english: A: “Fast fashion” clothing is only popular for the first few months after it comes out. B: Oh? Do you mean that “fast fashion” clothes quickly lose their charm?

examples.chinese: 外面風大雨大，媽媽只好把還沒乾的衣服收進來，掛在屋內。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēng dà yǔ dà, māma zhǐhǎo bǎ hái méi gān de yīfu shōu jìnlái, guà zài wū nèi.
examples.english: Outside the wind and rain were strong, so Mom had no choice but to bring in the clothes that were not yet dry and hang them inside the house.

examples.chinese: 是啊，因為這個牌子很有名，衣服、褲子和裙子也都很好看，所以很多人買。
examples.pinyin: Shì a, yīnwèi zhè ge páizi hěn yǒumíng, yīfu, kùzi hé qúnzi yě dōu hěn hǎokàn, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén mǎi.
examples.english: Yes, it is. This brand is very famous and its tops, pants and skirts are very beautiful, so many people buy it.

examples.chinese: 妳知道去哪裡買這個牌子的衣服嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào qù nǎlǐ mǎi zhè ge páizi de yīfu ma?
examples.english: Do you know where you can get this clothing brand?

examples.chinese: 我很想去看，可是我最近胖了五公斤，我怕衣服不好買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎng qù kàn, kěshì wǒ zuìjìn pàng le wǔ gōngjīn, wǒ pà yīfu bù hǎo mǎi.
examples.english: I would like to check it out. But I have recently gained 5 kilograms, so I am worried that they don’t have my size.

examples.chinese: 妳胖了嗎？我不覺得啊，我跟妳一起去看。我也想去買今年夏天的新衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ pàng le ma? Wǒ bù juéde a, wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù kàn. Wǒ yě xiǎng qù mǎi jīnnián xiàtiān de xīn yīfu.
examples.english: Have you gained weight? I don’t think so. I can go check with you. I would like to buy the new summer collections.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有的舊東西很不錯，有的新東西也很有趣，我很喜歡看新車、新衣服，可是因為我的錢不多，所以我不常買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒude jiù dōngxi hěn búcuò, yǒude xīn dōngxi yě hěn yǒuqù, wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn xīn chē, xīn yīfu, kěshì yīnwèi wǒ de qián bù duō, suǒyǐ wǒ bù cháng mǎi.
examples.english: I think some old stuff is good and some new ones are interesting. I like to check the new car, new clothes out, but I do not have much money, so I don’t buy them often.

items.wordHook: 衣(garment) + 服(clothing) → 衣服 is what you wear.

examples.chinese: 這個地方好漂亮，我好喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìfāng hǎo piàoliang, wǒ hǎo xǐhuān.
examples.english: This place is so beautiful; I really like it.

examples.chinese: （看地圖）啊！天美飯店在這裡！我知道這個地方，附近有郵局跟超級市場。
examples.pinyin: (Kàn dìtú) A! Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài zhèlǐ! Wǒ zhīdào zhè ge dìfang, fùjìn yǒu yóujú gēn chāojíshìchǎng.
examples.english: (Looking at the map) Ah! So here is Tianmei Hotel! I know this place. There is a post office and a supermarket nearby.

examples.chinese: 世界很大，沒去過的地方我都想去。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè hěn dà, méi qù guo de dìfang wǒ dōu xiǎng qù.
examples.english: The world is big; I want to go to all the places I haven't been to.

examples.chinese: 我不知道那個地方怎麼去，所以應該先查查地圖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào nàge dìfāng zěnme qù, suǒyǐ yīnggāi xiān chácha dìtú.
examples.english: I don't know how to get to that place, so I should first check the map.

examples.chinese: 大人應該把刀子放在安全的地方，要不然小孩子碰了，可能會受傷。
examples.pinyin: Dàrén yīnggāi bǎ dāozi fàng zài ānquán de dìfāng, yàobùrán xiǎoháizi pèng le, kěnéng huì shòushāng.
examples.english: Adults should put knives in a safe place; otherwise, if children touch them, they might get hurt.

examples.chinese: 小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi. Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english: Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes. My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 最近很多人感冒了，不過不必太擔心，只要戴上口罩、別去人多的地方就行了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén gǎnmào le, bùguò bùbì tài dānxīn, zhǐyào dài shàng kǒuzhào, bié qù rén duō de dìfāng jiù xíng le.
examples.english: Many people have caught colds recently, but you don't need to worry too much; as long as you wear a mask and don't go to crowded places, it's all right.

examples.chinese: 這裡的每一樣產品都是老闆自己設計的，別的地方找不到相同的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de měi yí yàng chǎnpǐn dōu shì lǎobǎn zìjǐ shèjì de, bié de dìfang zhǎo bú dào xiāngtóng de.
examples.english: Every kind of product here is designed by the owner himself; you can't find the same ones elsewhere.

examples.chinese: 小周才三十歲，就去過四十幾個國家，甚至去過一些又危險又刺激的地方，真是太酷了！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōu cái sānshí suì, jiù qùguò sìshí jǐ gè guójiā, shènzhì qùguò yīxiē yòu wēixiǎn yòu cìjī de dìfāng, zhēn shì tài kù le!
examples.english: Xiao Zhou is only thirty years old, but has already been to over forty countries, and even some dangerous and exciting places—that's really so cool!

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方不算偏僻，但是附近沒有公車站，所以自行車成了我最常利用的交通工具。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng bù suàn piānpì, dànshì fùjìn méiyǒu gōngchēzhàn, suǒyǐ zìxíngchē chéng le wǒ zuì cháng lìyòng de jiāotōng gōngjù.
examples.english: The place I live is not considered remote, but there is no bus stop nearby, so the bicycle has become the transportation tool I use most often.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方很偏僻，手機常收不到訊息，朋友很難跟我聯絡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng hěn piānpì, shǒujī cháng shōu bù dào xùnxí, péngyǒu hěn nán gēn wǒ liánluò.
examples.english: The place I live is very remote; my phone often can't receive information, and it's hard for friends to contact me.

examples.chinese: 前天的強烈颱風帶來了大雨，很多地方都淹水了。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān de qiángliè táifēng dài lái le dàyǔ, hěn duō dìfāng dōu yānshuǐ le.
examples.english: The strong typhoon the day before yesterday brought heavy rain, and many places were flooded.

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

items.wordHook: 地(earth) + 方(direction) → a place is a direction on earth.

examples.chinese: 女生和男生都喜歡去百貨公司買東西。
examples.pinyin: Nǚshēng hé nánshēng dōu xǐhuān qù bǎihuò gōngsī mǎi dōngxi.
examples.english: Both girls and boys like to go to the department store to shop.

examples.chinese: 很多年輕男生愛在書店看汽車雜誌，汽車很貴，他們不一定可以買新車，可是都看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng nánshēng ài zài shūdiàn kàn qìchē zázhì, qìchē hěn guì, tāmen bù yídìng kěyǐ mǎi xīn chē, kěshì dōu kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Many young men like to read car magazines at bookstores. Cars are expensive and they don’t usually have the money to buy new ones; however, they are very happy just by reading those magazines.

examples.chinese: 方小姐既活潑又漂亮，難怪不少男生想追求她。
examples.pinyin: Fāng xiǎojiě jì huópō yòu piàoliang, nánguài bùshǎo nánshēng xiǎng zhuīqiú tā.
examples.english: Miss Fang is both lively and pretty; no wonder many guys want to pursue her.

items.wordHook: 男(male) + 生(birth) → a boy from birth; at school, a male student: 男生(boy).

examples.chinese: 我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne. Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english: When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought. That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese: 小時候爺爺常陪我做功課、教我打球和釣魚，現在回想起那段時間，感覺真幸福。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou yéye cháng péi wǒ zuò gōngkè, jiāo wǒ dǎqiú hé diàoyú, xiànzài huíxiǎng qǐ nà duàn shíjiān, gǎnjué zhēn xìngfú.
examples.english: When I was little, my grandfather often accompanied me to do homework and taught me to play ball and fish; now when I recall that time, I feel truly happy.

examples.chinese: 易先生對戲劇有很大的興趣，小時候的夢想就是當一名成功的演員。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng duì xìjù yǒu hěn dà de xìngqù, xiǎoshíhou de mèngxiǎng jiùshì dāng yì míng chénggōng de yǎnyuán.
examples.english: Mr. Yi has a great interest in drama; his childhood dream was to become a successful actor.

examples.chinese: 他們從小時候就很要好，有困難時一起解決，有好東西也會分給對方。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen cóng xiǎoshíhou jiù hěn yàohǎo, yǒu kùnnán shí yīqǐ jiějué, yǒu hǎo dōngxi yě huì fēn gěi duìfāng.
examples.english: They have been close friends since childhood; when they have difficulties, they solve them together, and when they have good things, they share them with each other.

examples.chinese: 從小時候起，他的第一志願就是當一位保護國家的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Cóng xiǎoshíhou qǐ, tā de dì-yī zhìyuàn jiùshì dāng yī wèi bǎohù guójiā de jūnrén.
examples.english: Since childhood, his first aspiration has been to be a soldier who protects the country.

examples.chinese: 我小時候最棒的休閒活動是到爺爺的菜園挖地種菜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou zuì bàng de xiūxián huódòng shì dào yéye de càiyuán wā dì zhòng cài.
examples.english: When I was a child, the best leisure activity was going to my grandfather's vegetable garden to dig the soil and plant vegetables.

examples.chinese: 明天我有空，我想去買皮包。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yǒu kòng, wǒ xiǎng qù mǎi píbāo.
examples.english: Tomorrow I have free time; I want to go buy a wallet.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

examples.chinese: 周先生買了一套用真皮做的沙發，坐起來很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu xiānsheng mǎi le yī tào yòng zhēnpí zuò de shāfā, zuò qǐlái hěn shūfu.
examples.english: Mr. Zhou bought a set of sofas made of genuine leather; they are very comfortable to sit on.

examples.chinese: 客人：這雙皮鞋我穿起來太緊了， 可以幫我換大一點的嗎？ 店員：沒問題，我幫你拿大一號的。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén: Zhè shuāng píxié wǒ chuān qǐlái tài jǐn le, kěyǐ bāng wǒ huàn dà yīdiǎn de ma? Diànyuán: Méi wèntí, wǒ bāng nǐ ná dà yī hào de.
examples.english: Customer: This pair of leather shoes is too tight for me; can you help me exchange them for a bigger size? Clerk: No problem, I'll get you a size larger.

examples.chinese: 冬天一到，我的皮膚就變得很乾，所以得注意保養。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān yí dào, wǒ de pífū jiù biàn de hěn gān, suǒyǐ děi zhùyì bǎoyǎng.
examples.english: As soon as winter arrives, my skin becomes very dry, so I have to pay attention to skincare.

examples.chinese: 那三家商店都賣相同牌子的皮包，我們最好先比個價，再決定買哪一家的。
examples.pinyin: Nà sān jiā shāngdiàn dōu mài xiāngtóng páizi de píbāo, wǒmen zuìhǎo xiān bǐ ge jià, zài juédìng mǎi nǎ yì jiā de.
examples.english: Those three stores all sell handbags of the same brand; we'd better compare prices first, then decide which one to buy from.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠生產的皮鞋、皮帶，不但品質好，價錢也不貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng shēngchǎn de píxié, pídài, bùdàn pǐnzhí hǎo, jiàqián yě bù guì.
examples.english: The leather shoes and belts that that factory produces are not only good in quality, but also not expensive in price.

examples.chinese: 為了避免皮膚受傷，夏天出門時別忘了戴上帽子和太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn pífū shòushāng, xiàtiān chūmén shí bié wàng le dài shàng màozi hé tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: To avoid skin injury, don't forget to put on a hat and sunglasses when going out in summer.

examples.chinese: 付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
examples.pinyin: Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán. Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english: When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk. He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!

examples.chinese: 我們公司打算今年跟美國合作，生產名牌皮包。除夕那天，大家都忙著打掃、貼春聯，只有弟弟很不合作，什麼事都不做。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī dǎsuàn jīnnián gēn Měiguó hézuò, shēngchǎn míngpái píbāo. Chúxī nà tiān, dàjiā dōu mángzhe dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, zhǐyǒu dìdi hěn bù hézuò, shénme shì dōu bù zuò.
examples.english: Our company plans to cooperate with the US this year to produce brand-name leather bags. On New Year's Eve, everyone was busy cleaning and putting up spring couplets; only my younger brother was very uncooperative and didn't do anything.

examples.chinese: 這個保養品很適合皮膚乾的人，所以秋冬兩個季節銷售得非常好。因為店員的服務態度很好，所以這個專櫃的銷售成績是最好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bǎoyǎngpǐn hěn shìhé pífū gān de rén, suǒyǐ qiū dōng liǎng ge jìjié xiāoshòu de fēicháng hǎo. Yīnwèi diànyuán de fúwù tàidù hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ zhège zhuān guì de xiāoshòu chéngjì shì zuì hǎo de.
examples.english: This skincare product is very suitable for people with dry skin, so its sales in the autumn and winter seasons are very good. Because the staff's service attitude is very good, this counter's sales performance is the best.

items.wordHook: A hanging hide takes a 攴(tap) and pulls free → the outer 皮(skin).

examples.chinese: 哥哥只要睡前喝太多水，就會夢到半夜起床找不到廁所，這樣的夢真可怕！
examples.pinyin: Gēge zhǐyào shuì qián hē tài duō shuǐ, jiù huì mèng dào bànyè qǐchuáng zhǎo bù dào cèsuǒ, zhèyàng de mèng zhēn kěpà!
examples.english: As long as my older brother drinks too much water before bed, he dreams of getting up in the middle of the night and not being able to find the toilet; such a dream is really scary!

examples.chinese: 我昨天晚上做了一個夢，夢到跟我最喜歡的明星一同演戲，開心得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le yī gè mèng, mèng dào gēn wǒ zuì xǐhuan de míngxīng yītóng yǎnxì, kāixīn de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Last night I had a dream; I dreamed of acting together with my favorite celebrity, and I was incredibly happy.

items.wordHook: Combining 夢(dream) and 到(go to): 夢到 means dream of.

examples.chinese: 我昨天晚上做了一個夢，夢到跟我最喜歡的明星一同演戲，開心得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le yī gè mèng, mèng dào gēn wǒ zuì xǐhuan de míngxīng yītóng yǎnxì, kāixīn de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Last night I had a dream; I dreamed of acting together with my favorite celebrity, and I was incredibly happy.

examples.chinese: 下週五有上百位家長會到我們學校，一同參加全校運動會。
examples.pinyin: Xià zhōuwǔ yǒu shàngbǎi wèi jiāzhǎng huì dào wǒmen xuéxiào, yìtóng cānjiā quánxiào yùndònghuì.
examples.english: Next Friday, hundreds of parents will come to our school to participate together in the whole-school sports meet.

items.wordHook: Walking as 一(one) group with the 同(same) shared purpose: 一同 means together.

examples.chinese: 軍人用卡車把食物和生活用品送到災區，發給需要的民眾。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén yòng kǎchē bǎ shíwù hé shēnghuó yòngpǐn sòng dào zāiqū, fā gěi xūyào de mínzhòng.
examples.english: Soldiers used trucks to deliver food and daily necessities to the disaster area and distribute them to the people in need.

examples.chinese: 這個紀念堂是為了紀念那些為國家犧牲生命的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìniàntáng shì wèile jìniàn nàxiē wèi guójiā xīshēng shēngmìng de jūnrén.
examples.english: This memorial hall is to commemorate those soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the country.

examples.chinese: 打仗期間，許多軍人為國家犧牲了寶貴的生命，也給家人留下了痛苦的記憶。
examples.pinyin: Dǎzhàng qījiān, xǔduō jūnrén wèi guójiā xīshēngle bǎoguì de shēngmìng, yě gěi jiārén liúxiàle tòngkǔ de jìyì.
examples.english: During the war, many soldiers sacrificed their precious lives for the country, and also left painful memories for their families.

examples.chinese: 這場大地震發生後不久，軍人就立刻趕到了災區，協助救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn fāshēng hòu bùjiǔ, jūnrén jiù lìkè gǎndàole zāiqū, xiézhù jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: Shortly after this major earthquake occurred, soldiers immediately rushed to the disaster area to assist with disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 到地震災區救災的軍人們，這幾天忙得連一頓飯都沒辦法好好地吃。
examples.pinyin: Dào dìzhèn zāiqū jiùzāi de jūnrénmen, zhè jǐ tiān máng de lián yí dùn fàn dōu méi bànfǎ hǎohǎo de chī.
examples.english: The soldiers who went to the earthquake disaster area for rescue have been so busy these days that they couldn't even properly eat a single meal.

examples.chinese: 從小時候起，他的第一志願就是當一位保護國家的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Cóng xiǎoshíhou qǐ, tā de dì-yī zhìyuàn jiùshì dāng yī wèi bǎohù guójiā de jūnrén.
examples.english: Since childhood, his first aspiration has been to be a soldier who protects the country.

examples.chinese: 軍人接到任務時，不管多麼危險都得努力完成。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén jiēdào rènwu shí, bùguǎn duōme wēixiǎn dōu děi nǔlì wánchéng.
examples.english: When soldiers receive a mission, no matter how dangerous it is, they must strive to complete it.

examples.chinese: 出國留學有不少好處，例如打開視野、增加自信、提高外文程度等等。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó liúxué yǒu bùshǎo hǎochù, lìrú dǎkāi shìyě, zēngjiā zìxìn, tígāo wàiwén chéngdù děngděng.
examples.english: Studying abroad has many benefits, for example, broadening one's horizons, increasing self-confidence, improving foreign language proficiency, and so on.

examples.chinese: 現代企業越來越重視員工的福利和健康，例如提供免費的旅遊和健檢。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài qǐyè yuèláiyuè zhòngshì yuángōng de fúlì hé jiànkāng, lìrú tígōng miǎnfèi de lǚyóu hé jiànjiǎn.
examples.english: Modern enterprises increasingly value employee benefits and health, for example, providing free travel and health checkups.

examples.chinese: 迷信的人老是相信一些不真實的迷信，例如：黑貓會帶來不好的運氣、送傘給情人就會分手什麼的。
examples.pinyin: Míxìn de rén lǎoshì xiāngxìn yīxiē bù zhēnshí de míxìn, lìrú: hēimāo huì dàilái bù hǎo de yùnqì, sòng sǎn gěi qíngrén jiù huì fēnshǒu shénme de.
examples.english: Superstitious people always believe in some untrue superstitions, for example: black cats will bring bad luck, giving an umbrella to a lover will lead to a breakup, and so on.

items.wordHook: Combining 例(precedent) and 如(if): 例如 means for example.

examples.chinese: 這兩個國家因為搶石油資源，而把對方當成了敵人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge guójiā yīnwèi qiǎng shíyóu zīyuán, ér bǎ duìfāng dāngchéng le dírén.
examples.english: These two countries, because they are fighting over oil resources, have regarded each other as enemies.

items.wordHook: Facing a hostile 敵(enemy) who acts as an opposing 人(person): 敵人 means enemy.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的年輕人愛喝咖啡，因此很多地方都是咖啡店比茶館多。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de niánqīngrén ài hē kāfēi, yīncǐ hěn duō dìfāng dōu shì kāfēidiàn bǐ cháguǎn duō.
examples.english: Young people in Taiwan love to drink coffee, so in many places there are more coffee shops than teahouses.

examples.chinese: 我來臺灣，算起來才三個月而已，卻已去過十幾家茶館了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ lái Táiwān, suàn qǐlái cái sān ge yuè éryǐ, què yǐ qùguo shí jǐ jiā cháguǎn le.
examples.english: In total, it has only been three months since I came to Taiwan, yet I have already been to more than ten tea houses.

examples.chinese: A:你要不要跟我一起去茶館喝杯茶？ B:與其去喝茶，我倒想去外面走走，看看花草樹木。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào bù yào gēn wǒ yīqǐ qù cháguǎn hē bēi chá? B: Yǔqí qù hē chá, wǒ dào xiǎng qù wàimiàn zǒuzǒu, kànkan huā cǎo shùmù.
examples.english: A: Do you want to go to the teahouse with me to have a cup of tea? B: Rather than go drink tea, I'd actually like to go for a walk outside and look at the flowers, grass, and trees.

examples.chinese: 這種植物的葉子尖尖的，流出來的汁又臭又黏，觀察時要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù de yèzi jiān jiān de, liú chūlái de zhī yòu chòu yòu nián, guānchá shí yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: The leaves of this plant are pointy, and the sap that flows out is both smelly and sticky; be careful when observing it.

examples.chinese: 關上燈、關上手機，這麼做你才能好好休息。
examples.pinyin: Guānshàng dēng, guānshàng shǒujī, zhème zuò nǐ cái néng hǎohǎo xiūxi.
examples.english: Turn off the lights, turn off your phone—only by doing this can you get a good rest.

examples.chinese: 部分大學科系對學生成績的要求非常高，畢業條件也較嚴格。
examples.pinyin: Bùfèn dàxué kēxì duì xuéshēng chéngjì de yāoqiú fēicháng gāo, bìyè tiáojiàn yě jiào yángé.
examples.english: Some university departments have very high requirements for student grades, and graduation conditions are also stricter.

items.wordHook: Combining 天(sky) and 上(above): 天上 means heaven.
昨(yesterday) + 天(day) → the day before today: 昨天(yesterday).
A 立(stand) at the 耑(special) end of the line — the very tip. That spot is the 端(end).
Turning warm 飠(food) over on its 反(reverse) side in the pan prepares a hot 飯(meal).
